name: 55303 · Anoka, MN
findings: ZIP 55303 (Anoka) has 167 nonprofit organizations. 77 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 56 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55303 (Anoka) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 13 religious organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 5 in similar places of this size.
